Messages.Author: Alexander Michels
Messages.Body:
A vampire rescued from torpor has 0 blood on him. Normally this minion
would have to immediately hunt. However, if his controller taps the coven
and places two blood on that minion, does she have to hunt anymore? Or was
the fact that she was at 0 blood (and untapped & capable of hunting)
sometime during her minion phase mean that she must now hunt even though
she has blood?

I've been scouring the newsgroup to find the answer, but can't find
anything that relevant.

Thanks,
Alexander Michels

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


If the vampire isn't at 0 blood, they're not required to hunt (barring
outside effects). So, yes, you could rescue the vampire, tap the coven
to put two blood on the vampire, and then they could go do something
else besides hunt.

http://groups.google.com/groups?q=author:LSJ+heidelburg+hunt&start=10&hl=en&lr=&ie=UTF-8&selm=38144635.6EF557C%40wizards.com&rnum=11

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
TunFiskeMad wrote:
> but correct me if i'm wrong but you are alowed to hunt more then once
> during a turn now ? - so as far as i understand u must allways hunt if
> u have 0 blood and there for there is no time to tap the coven when
> the minion is out of torper.
> This is how i understand it please correct me if im wrong (and sorry
> for the bad spelling ect.)

The Coven can be tapped between actions. Before the mandatory hunt.
Afterwards, the hunt is no longer mandatory, since the vampire has
blood.

Messages.Body:
"TunFiskeMad" <mikkelp...@ofir.dk> wrote in message

> u have 0 blood and there for there is no time to tap the coven when
> the minion is out of torper.
> This is how i understand it please correct me if im wrong (and sorry
> for the bad spelling ect.)

As LSJ says, there is time between actions to do non-action stuff. A
mandatory hunt just means that the _next_ action you take has to be a hunt
action. It doesn't mean that you're not allowed to do other (non-action)
stuff...
